newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rugby Union-Carel du Plessis factfile.
newsitem.headline: Rugby Union-Carel du Plessis factfile.

text.p: Factfile on the life and career of new Springbok coach Carel du Plessis who was appointed on Tuesday:
Full name: Carel Johan du Plessis
Educated: Paarl Boys high school and Stellenbosch University

Family connections with rugby: Father Willie brilliant Eastern Province winger whose career was cut short by broken leg. Brothers Willie and Michael also played for Western Province and South Africa. Fourth brother Jacques played for Eastern Province
Rugby career: Western Province (1982-86, 1988-89) and Transvaal (1987). 108 appearances for Western Province, 57 as captain, scoring 81 tries
Springbok debut: 1981 tour of New Zealand
Test debut against South America in 1982
Honours: Five Currie Cups wins with Western Province (1982, 1983, 1984, 1986 and 1989) and two losing finals in 1987 (with Transvaal) and 1988 (with Western Province)
Most famous try: Running almost 100 metres to score for the Southern Hemisphere against the Northern Hemisphere at Twickenham in 1983
Wife: Lisa, son Jean-Luc and daughter Lara
Post-rugby: Gilt trader and partner in Cape Town financial services company
